page_title: Mos | Smooth scrolling for mouse wheels on macOS

sources.entry: Mos - Simple tool can offer the smooth scrolling and reverse the mouse scrolling direction on your Mac. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/Caldis/Mos) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Mos
summary.one_liner: Mos is a free macOS utility that smooths mouse wheel scrolling like a trackpad and lets you bind mouse buttons to actions.
keywords: make mouse wheel feel like trackpad
use_cases: Make a regular mouse wheel scroll smoothly on a Mac
Set different scroll feel for different apps
Bind an extra mouse button to Mission Control
Switch spaces or apps with a mouse button
Reverse mouse scroll direction on macOS
summary.what_it_does: Mos reshapes mouse wheel input on macOS so scrolling becomes smooth and continuous instead of fixed steps, using an algorithm described as based on physical inertia. It lets each app have its own scroll curve and behavior, with options for precise or smooth scrolling. It supports binding mouse buttons, including button 4, button 5 and wheel click, to quick actions such as Mission Control, Next Space and App Switcher. The page also mentions independent axis tuning and the ability to reverse scroll direction, as listed in the awesome-mac directory.
notable: Mouse button and wheel click bindings to actions like Mission Control and App Switcher
